Needs changes before merge. Set `needs-rework` for the two items below.

This is the first review. I read the complete diff and checked the current upstream rules. The alias table preserves both old names. The command, project-load, option-key, and undo checks pass. `Process change: yes` is present. The PR does not edit `PROCESS_VERSION`.

**Local build and tests**

I tested the trial merge `7fe5e43f058596081119e5bfcbe12d73e7dad851` with main `138a592a196a6c68e8608b560fbd2696977a71c7`. Its first parent is the PR head above. No GitHub runner ran. The cache wrapper stalled during the initial planner build. I stopped that build and ran verification with `RUSTC_WRAPPER=` and `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1`.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: the geometry text change selected the batch fallback. All builds passed. Of 1,216 steps, 1,213 passed and three UI steps failed. There were no stalls. Clippy with `-D warnings` passed.
- `wire_post_alias`: 6 passed. `agie_native`: 37 passed. `conformance`: 7 passed. `mcp_wire_contour`: 9 passed. `plasma_post_refusals`: 7 passed.
- `comment_escape`: 4 passed. Geometry lib: 77 passed. All three changed `egui_app::tests::agie_post` tests passed.
- `cargo xtask gate light --only motion --only app`: all 11 light tests passed across five targets. This selects every light test. It omits the broad release prebuild; Cargo builds each selected target. No full heavy lane ran.

**Extra suites run**

These suites ran by name in the quick fallback:

- `example_catalog`: 43 passed, 4 ignored.
- `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed.
- `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
- `script_agie_native`: 11 passed. This suite reads the changed refusal directory through `recorded::check`.
- The other post golden suites passed. Kernel `step_agreement`: 29 passed; kernel `machining_mesh`: 7 passed; app `feature_edge_g1_join`: 5 passed. No importer code or STEP fixture changed.

**Host failures checked on bare main**

This headless host has no GPU adapter available to these tests. I ran the same three UI suites on bare main `138a592a1`:

```text
cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --lib --test egui_app --test shell --no-fail-fast -- --test-threads=6
```

Both trees give the same results:

| Suite | Passed | Failed | Ignored |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| UI lib | 1671 | 7 | 8 |
| UI egui_app | 5 | 3 | 0 |
| UI shell | 20 | 1 | 0 |

The failed test names match exactly. Six report-picture tests fail with:

```text
Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
```

The other five failures report `no graphics adapter` or the resulting nonzero CLI exit code. These are pre-existing host failures. They do not block this PR. No tracking issue was identified.

**Safety and goldens**

The diff changes names, refusal text, and alias resolution. It changes no geometry calculation, collision check, stock simulation, or posted coordinate. A safety-tier mutation run does not apply. No mutations ran.

I checked all 11 changed `.refusal` goldens line by line. Only line 2 changes its refusal text. The `(user.cps:16:9)` locations remain unchanged. The posted job goldens do not change, and their Agie job checks pass.

**Requested before merge**

1. **Class: missing UI evidence.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog_tabs.rs:36` changes visible text. The post name, dialog messages, and Wire-page hint also change. The PR body has no before/after screenshots. Add before/after screenshots for the changed UI to the body. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Do not commit images or review evidence to the PR branch.
2. **Class: incomplete legacy-project post test.** `crates/app/tests/wire_post_alias.rs:101` calls `script_source()`. This reads the CPS text; it does not post a job. Issue #4000 requires the opened legacy project to post and then save the new name. Extend the existing round-trip coverage to load a valid job with each old name. Post each loaded job to a new directory. Compare its ISO, SBR, and SBL files with the unchanged goldens. Then check that the save writes the new name. Apply this check to both old aliases.

No production-code defect was found. The two requested items concern required evidence and acceptance coverage. The review worktree and branch remain in place for the next round.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Reply to the review of head 028530986. The new head is 1b080d420. The PR keeps its ready flag (#3727). The new head waits for a fresh review.

**Item 1. Class: missing UI evidence.**
- The PR body has a new section "Screenshots (review item 1)" with five before/after pairs:
  - the post list on the Setup > Post page;
  - the Post dialog with its scope line and output texts;
  - the refusal for "One file per operation";
  - the status line after the post;
  - the hint on the Wire page open-cut rows.
- "Before" is `origin/main` 3bb6647f6. "After" is the PR head.
- The images are only on the fork branch `pr-screenshots`, folder `pr-4022/`. The PR branch has no image.
- A temporary ignored kittest test saved `h.render()`. It is not committed.
- The folder picker title is a native window. The harness cannot render it.
- Rule for the class: each changed visible text has one before/after pair in the body.

**Item 2. Class: incomplete legacy-project post test.** Commit 1b080d420.
- New test `a_project_saved_with_each_old_name_posts_the_unchanged_job_and_saves_the_new_name` in `crates/app/tests/agie_native/legacy_name.rs`. It is a submodule of the existing `agie_native` suite. It reuses the control-checked punch fixture and the job goldens of that suite.
- For each of the two old names, the test does these steps:
  1. It saves the punch with the old name as the post and in the option key.
  2. It opens that file in a new world.
  3. It posts to a new temporary directory, with no per-run option override.
  4. It compares `CCSEP20.ISO`, `CCSEP20.SBR` and `CCSEP20.SBL` byte for byte with the unchanged goldens.
  5. It saves again and checks that the file has the new name and no old name.
- In `wire_post_alias.rs`, the `script_source()` check stays, with a correct message. The test name no longer says "posts".
- The decision file records why the test is in `agie_native`.

**Gate on 1b080d420 (macOS).**
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: batch fallback, 1215 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: exit 0.

Ready for a re-check.

Label: `conflicts` (orange). The clean review of head 1b080d420 is posted; `main` (#4002) has added `lead_arc_radius` to the same Wire Contour row that this PR renames, so the branch conflicts with `origin/main` (`.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`). The author refreshes the branch (`git merge origin/main`, keep both sides) and pushes; the review re-runs at that head. `needs-rework` is removed: the two items it named are satisfied at this head. A fork PR's draft state is left as its contributor set it.

Refresh with main. The new head is `87805dcf9`.

**Merge.** Merge commit `e212b0b87` merges `origin/main` at `83d52ef6a` into the branch.
- One file had a conflict: `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`, the Wire Contour row.
- The resolution keeps both sides. The row keeps the `lead_arc_radius` field and its text from #4002. The row also keeps the new post name `"Agie Wire EDM (AgieVision)"` and the text "an AgieVision job directory of ISO, SBR and SBL files" from this PR.
- `git diff origin/main --stat` lists only the files of this PR.
- I searched the merged tree for "native wire EDM", "native controller" and the two old post names. The text from main adds no new use of them. The remaining uses are the alias table, the script receipt `format` value, the tests of the old names and the decision records. `wire_post_alias::no_source_text_names_the_post_native_wire_edm` passes.

**One more commit.** Commit `87805dcf9` adds `lead_arc_radius: None,` to `crates/app/tests/wire_post/model_arcs.rs`. Main at `83d52ef6a` did not compile the `wire_post` test binary (#4058). This is the same line as the fix of #4058 (PR #4064, now on main). The branch merges cleanly with the current main `aef12fea6` (`git merge-tree`).

**Gate on `87805dcf9`:**
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: the diff touches `crates/geometry`, thus quick fell back to the batch plan. 1217 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, 39.7 min. This includes `agie_native`, `wire_post`, `wire_post_alias`, `sodick_wire_post`, `post suites: script_agie_native`, `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, the ui suites and `clippy -D warnings`.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- P7: no heavy step.

Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).

Refresh with main. The new head is `ca5f06173`. The PR keeps its ready flag (#3727).

**Merge.** Merge commit `ca5f06173` merges `origin/main` at `de035b4c3` into the branch. Four files had a conflict. Each conflict is a "both sides added lines" case:
- `assets/posts/AGENTS.md`: the branch keeps its "Agie Wire EDM (AgieVision)" paragraph and also keeps the new `sodick-ln2w.cps` paragraph from main (#4045).
- `crates/app/tests/conformance.rs`: `WIRE_POSTS` keeps the new row `("Sodick Wire EDM (LN2W)", "sodick-ln2w")` from main. The Agie row uses the new name `"Agie Wire EDM (AgieVision)"`. The old row `"Native wire EDM job files"` from main is not kept.
- `site/content/guide/check-and-post/machines.md`: the wire row lists the posts of the two sides (Sodick LN2W and Agie Wire EDM (AgieVision)) and the machines of the two sides (Sodick ALC400G, Sodick AQ600L, AGIECUT Classic 2S template).
- `site/content/guide/check-and-post/posting.md`: the table keeps the new Sodick LN2W row from main and the renamed Agie row of this branch. The old row "Native wire EDM job files" is not kept.

**Checks.**
- `git diff origin/main --stat` lists only the files of this PR. `crates/app/tests/wire_post/model_arcs.rs` is now the same on the two sides: main added the same `lead_arc_radius` line (`8f75bb9c6`).
- I searched the merged tree for "native wire EDM" and "native controller". Main added no new text with an old name outside the history files (`CHANGELOG.md`, `RECOMMENDED.md`, `RELEASE_NOTES.md`). The only hits in the source are the alias table, the script `format` value, and the alias note in `assets/posts/AGENTS.md`. `wire_post_alias` is green.
- After the gate, main moved to `f0bdc5109`. `git merge-tree` of the new head with `f0bdc5109` is clean, and the same search on that tree has no hit. GitHub reports `MERGEABLE`.

**Gate on `ca5f06173`** (macOS, the log starts with the head SHA):
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: the diff touches `crates/geometry/src/die_opening.rs`, so quick falls back to batch. 1224 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, 36.6 min. `app suites: wire_post_alias` and `app suites: conformance` are green.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Delta class.** `cargo xtask merge-plan --delta 4022 --reviewed 1b080d420` says NEW CODE:
- `e212b0b8`: a merge of main, hand-resolved (`.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`). That refresh is from 2026-11-25.
- `87805dcf`: the one-line fixture fix in `model_arcs.rs`. Main now has the same line.
- `ca5f0617`: this merge of main, hand-resolved (the four files above).

The review of the commits after `1b080d420` is a review of the two hand resolutions and of the one-line fixture fix.

Ready for a re-check.

Reviewer: uma pool job review-4022, GPT-6 (Codex), mkinney/Codex; did not write or refresh this PR.

Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking finding. The head is `MERGEABLE`.

This is a new review after the author's branch refresh. I used the current upstream `AGENTS.md` at `dc3679fb51573f9c359cb84bdd60ea4a85ea7693`. I read the two merge resolutions and the fixture fix since the last reviewed head. I also checked the resulting diff against current main. No GitHub runner ran.

**Earlier findings**

1. Branch conflict: fixed by `e212b0b87` and `ca5f06173`. The Wire Contour skill row keeps main's `lead_arc_radius` field and this PR's Agie name. The later resolution keeps both the Sodick LN2W and Agie rows in the conformance test and site tables. The two post paragraphs remain. The `model_arcs.rs` fixture fix is now also on main. The local trial merge is clean; `mcp_wire_contour`, `wire_post` and `conformance` pass.
2. UI evidence: fixed. I opened all ten images from the five before/after pairs in the PR body. They show the post list, dialog text, per-operation refusal, status line and Wire-page hint. The links use the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. No image is added to the PR branch. The body states why the native folder picker has no harness image.
3. Legacy-project posting coverage: fixed by `1b080d420`. `agie_native::legacy_name::a_project_saved_with_each_old_name_posts_the_unchanged_job_and_saves_the_new_name` passes. For both old names it opens the saved project, posts without a per-run option override, compares ISO, SBR and SBL bytes with the unchanged goldens, then saves with the new name.

**Local build and tests**

Trial merge: `7263b1ddcf33ba37054b605fd6017a612e1d08f7`. Its first parent is the full PR head above. Its second parent is main `dc3679fb51573f9c359cb84bdd60ea4a85ea7693`. The tests ran in `.claude/worktrees/review-4022`, with six jobs and the cache wrapper disabled.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` selected the batch fallback because the geometry refusal text changed. Eight crate test builds passed. The app test build stopped on the pre-existing compile error below. The remaining batch steps did not run; this is not a full green batch result.

I then ran a filtered quick gate with the affected targets. All 13 selected test steps passed:

| Suite | Passed | Failed | Ignored |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| geometry lib | 77 | 0 | 0 |
| post `comment_escape` | 4 | 0 | 0 |
| post `script_agie_native` | 11 | 0 | 0 |
| app `agie_native` | 38 | 0 | 0 |
| app `conformance` | 7 | 0 | 0 |
| app `mcp_wire_contour` | 10 | 0 | 0 |
| app `plasma_post_refusals` | 7 | 0 | 0 |
| app `wire_post` | 28 | 0 | 0 |
| app `wire_post_alias` | 6 | 0 | 0 |
| app `example_catalog` | 43 | 0 | 4 |
| app `example_catalog_adaptive` | 1 | 0 | 0 |
| app `example_catalog_edge_work` | 1 | 0 | 0 |
| UI lib, from `crates/ui` | 1711 | 0 | 8 |

Clippy with `--all-targets -- -D warnings` stopped on the same pre-existing compile error. I ran both the app `--no-run` build and the same clippy gate step on bare main `dc3679fb5`. Both fail in the same way:

```text
error[E0063]: missing field `entry` in initializer of `camcraft_app::operation::OpParams`
  --> crates/app/tests/start_exit_shared/hole_order.rs:74:5
74 |     OpParams::Bore {
   |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ missing `entry`
```

This file is unchanged by the PR. The error does not block this review. No open tracking issue was found by the `start_exit_shared` search. Clippy is not reported as a pass.

`cargo xtask gate light --only motion --only app`: all five targets passed, with 11 tests and zero failures or stalls. This runs all light twins. It omits the broad release prebuild; Cargo builds each selected target. No full heavy lane ran.

**Extra suites run**

The three `example_catalog*` suites above ran by name. `script_agie_native` reads the changed refusal-golden directory through the shared recorded-post harness; all 11 cases pass. No model fixture or importer implementation changed, so the extra importer suites do not apply.

**Safety and goldens**

This PR changes names, refusal text and alias resolution. It changes no posted motion, geometry calculation, collision check or stock simulation. A safety-tier mutation run does not apply. No mutation ran and no code was changed for this review.

I checked the 11 changed refusal goldens line by line. Only line 2 changes its message; `(user.cps:16:9)` stays the same. The ISO, SBR and SBL goldens do not change. Their byte comparisons pass. The new alias table preserves both old names. Project loading, option keys, commands, script lookup and the machine-post check use that table.

`Process change: yes` is present. The PR does not edit `PROCESS_VERSION`. The decision record, `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #4000` are present. No dependency, build script, workflow or executable script change requires a maintainer-only build decision.

Requested changes: none. The worktree and `review-4022` branch remain for the next round. The author is qsmits; I leave the ready state as set by the author. `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` is not set in this Codex session; `review-4022` above is the assigned review task name.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

left for the maintainer: check 6 skip - the PR touches the post script and geometry (assets/posts/agie-native.cps, crates/geometry/src/die_opening.rs), which the merge sweep does not merge. Counted clean review at ca5f06173 (uma pool job, trial-merge clean with main dc3679fb5; main moved one merge since); quick gate green apart from the bare-main break in start_exit_shared/hole_order.rs (issue #4155, reproduced on bare main). Posting only one comment here.
